1064 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and 4th century, but not 100? Actually 1064 is not a century year, so divisible by 4 means leap year).  
June has 30 days.  
2 weeks + 2 days = 16 days.  
June 29 + 16 days = June 29 + 1 day = June 30, then +15 more days = July 15.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1064-07-15
